applies_why: The judge text makes lack of explicit textual resolution of paternity the reason for marking the link UNDERDETERMINED.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: ‘without explicit textual resolution’ — read as a permissible basis for UNDERDETERMINED versus read, under K-S2, as precisely an impermissible lack-of-explicit-verse-statement ground.
why: The entry assigns UNDERDETERMINED because the textual material lacks an explicit resolution of paternity, which K-S2 forbids as a ground for that verdict.
